newsitem.title: UK: New CSC warehouse wins Martinair's backing.
newsitem.headline: New CSC warehouse wins Martinair's backing.

text.p: Dutch airline Martinair said in a statement, it is backing Cargo Service Center's (CSC) move to new premises in the UK next year, with a three year freight handling contract.
The new contract takes effect from March 1,1997, when CSC will have doubled its current handling capacity, the statement added.
CSC will work closely with Cranleigh Freight Services, which operates a three-times-daily trucking service between Heathrow and Amsterdam Schiphol Airport.

The handler will be responsible for the build up and breakdown of cargo while Cranleigh, who will have a full time representative stationed at CSC's warehouse, will transport each consignment between the UK and Holland.

Martinair's current annual London freight throughput is in the region of 10,000 tonnes and this is expected to increase later this year when the carrier introduces a new freighter service to Africa, serving Johannesburg, Harare and Nairobi, the statement said.
